entities.name: Eratosthenes Measures the Earth
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Using shadow angles at Alexandria and Syene during the summer solstice, Eratosthenes calculated Earth's circumference to within 2% accuracy. Pure geometry, no instruments beyond a stick.
